name: Helicone
description: Monitors LLM and agent traffic through a one-line proxy integration, logging requests, costs and latency with caching, rate limits and evaluations built in.

skills.name: Request Logging
skills.description: Logs every prompt, completion, cost and latency figure through a proxy or async API with a one-line change.

skills.name: Caching And Rate Limits
skills.description: Caches repeated completions and enforces per-user rate limits at the gateway to cut spend and abuse.

skills.name: Session Tracing
skills.description: Groups multi-step agent calls into sessions so a whole run can be replayed and debugged as one unit.
